classification.difficultyReason: Find the scale factor from the widths (2.5), scale the unlabelled height (4 to 10), then compute the area. This is routine two-step similar-rectangles work with the diagram supplied.

content.prompt: Determine the area of the scaled rectangle.

answer.worked:
The scale factor is $15\div6=2.5$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Large height}&=4\times2.5=10\text{ cm}\\\text{Large area}&=15\times10=150\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$
